question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Hospitality** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Hospitality **means the friendly and generous reception and entertainment of guests or strangers. (मेहमानों या अजनबियों का मैत्रीपूर्ण और उदार स्वागत और मनोरंजन) • **Example**: *The hotel staff's hospitality made the guests feel welcomed and comfortable throughout their stay.* • *​*The sentence discusses the services or treatment provided by someone, specifically focusing on giving a ride and sponsoring food. • The term "**hospitality**" is particularly relevant in this context as it encompasses the idea of providing a welcoming and generous reception to guests or strangers. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Brevity: **Conciseness and the quality of being brief or short in duration. (संक्षिप्तता और अवधि में संक्षिप्त या कम होने की गुणवत्ता) • **Stringency: **Strictness, severity, or the quality of being stringent or demanding. (सख़्ती, गंभीरता, या कठोर होने या मांग करने का गुण) • **Conformity: **Compliance with established rules, standards, or conventions; acting in accordance with prevailing norms. (स्थापित नियमों, मानकों, या सम्मेलनों का अनुपालन; प्रचलित मानदंडों के अनुसार कार्य करना) 41:Tcbb, The correct answer is: **Humaneness**
